reason: 除藻机器人，非日历产品。。页面证据：Algal blooms in Lake Taihu cost the government of Wuxi, China a lot of money. The blue-green algal bloom generated by water eutrophication has damaged the aquatic environment and has negative health impacts on humans and animals. HUBOT is a remotely controlled robot that absorbs pollutants and mixes the upper and lower water layers to suppress the growth of blue-green algae. It also assists in salvage activities. A closed loop has been formed by using the waste resources to solve the problem itself.
